Project: MyHarvestHub – Comprehensive 
Feature Blueprint 
Vision: 
To create a unified, AI-powered, and trust-driven marketplace ecosystem that merges 
services (Fiverr), group buying (Groupon), e-commerce (Shopify), wholesale (Alibaba), and 
general retail (Temu) into one cohesive digital economy — underpinned by a secure wallet 
system and transparent supply chain management. 
1. 
�
�
 User Management & Access Control 
Core Features: 
● Multi-role account types: Buyer, Seller, Service Provider, Wholesaler, Admin 
● Standard authentication (email, phone, social login) 
● Passwordless & biometric login (for mobile) 
● Multi-language & localization setup 
● Profile creation (personal, business, service) 
● KYC/AML verification via 3rd-party integrations (e.g., Jumio, Persona) 
● Two-factor authentication (2FA) 
Advanced Features: 
● AI-driven onboarding wizard (suggests relevant features based on user intent) 
● Unified account view across all marketplace verticals 
● User reputation score (aggregated across services, products, and reviews) 
● Smart segmentation (e.g., “Frequent Buyers,” “Top Sellers,” “Verified Pros”) 
Differentiators: 
● Universal Hub Identity — one profile, multiple roles across service and product 
ecosystems 
● Dynamic Role Switching — seamlessly toggle between buyer, seller, and service 
provider modes 
2. 
�
�
 Marketplace Framework (General + E-Commerce) 
Core Features: 
● Product listing (title, description, variants, SKU, price) 
● Seller storefronts (custom branding, themes, policies) 
● Search, filter, and sort (by relevance, popularity, rating) 
● Product reviews & ratings 
● Shopping cart & checkout flow 
● Multi-currency & tax calculation 
● Order tracking & management dashboard 
Advanced Features: 
● AI-driven product recommendations 
● Inventory synchronization (for sellers with multiple channels) 
● Dynamic pricing engine 
● AR product previews and 3D product visualization 
● Subscription-based products 
Differentiators: 
● Unified Buyer Experience — shop, book, or bulk-buy from one cart 
● AI “Smart Bundles” — recommends combos of services + products (e.g., a “farm 
produce package” + “delivery service”) 
3. 
⚙
 Service Marketplace (Fiverr-like) 
Core Features: 
● Service listings with packages (Basic, Standard, Premium) 
● Gig creation with milestones, delivery deadlines, revisions 
● Order management & delivery tracking 
● Buyer-seller chat & negotiation 
● Ratings and portfolio display 
Advanced Features: 
● Escrow-based payments with release on delivery confirmation 
● Skill verification badges 
● Smart contract generation for large-value services 
● AI-driven proposal assistance for service providers 
Differentiators: 
● Hybrid Gigs — ability to pair a physical product with a related service 
● Team-Based Services — enable group-based service delivery for larger projects 
4. 
�
�
 Wallet & Payment Ecosystem 
Core Features: 
● In-app wallet (deposit, withdraw, send, receive) 
● Escrow management (service delivery protection) 
● Transaction history and downloadable statements 
● Integration with major payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, local PSPs) 
● Currency conversion and FX rates display 
Advanced Features: 
● Cashback & rewards program 
● Crypto-compatible wallet extension (optional future phase) 
● P2P transfers between users 
● Split payments for group purchases 
● Automated revenue share (for affiliate or referral partners) 
Differentiators: 
● Smart Wallet Layer — powers services, products, and group buys seamlessly 
● Unified Ledger View — displays spending across all verticals with insights & trends 
5. 
�
�
 Group Buying & Deals (Groupon-style) 
Core Features: 
● Time-bound group deals 
● Minimum order quantity logic (deal activates when threshold is met) 
● Discount tiers (based on participation volume) 
● Invite friends/share-to-unlock features 
● Real-time deal progress tracker 
Advanced Features: 
● AI-curated deal suggestions (based on user intent & browsing) 
● “Community Deals” — user-created group purchases 
● Geo-targeted deals (based on city/region) 
● Dynamic pricing drop alerts 
Differentiators: 
● Cross-Vertical Group Buying — e.g., combine product + delivery + warranty services 
● Smart Incentives — users earn wallet credits for hosting or filling group deals 
6. 
�
�
 Wholesale Marketplace (Alibaba-like) 
Core Features: 
● B2B supplier profiles with certifications 
● RFQ (Request for Quotation) workflow 
● Bulk order management (MOQ, negotiation) 
● Shipping & logistics integration (freight forwarding options) 
● Secure escrow for high-value orders 
Advanced Features: 
● Trade assurance system 
● Supplier performance dashboards 
● Automated invoice generation 
● Custom product sourcing (buyer requests, supplier bids) 
● Integration with ERP systems (for large suppliers) 
Differentiators: 
● Multi-tier Pricing — wholesale, retail, and service tiers coexist 
● Verified Supply Chain Transparency — sustainability and origin tracking

 Search, Discovery & Personalization 
Core Features: 
● Universal search bar across all modules 
● Category, keyword, and AI intent-based search 
● Auto-suggest and predictive results 
● Trending products & services 
Advanced Features: 
● AI-powered personalization (behavioral & contextual) 
● Semantic search for natural language queries 
● Visual search (image-to-product matching) 
● Cross-domain recommendations (service + product) 
Differentiators: 
● Unified Discovery Engine — integrates services, wholesale, and products in one feed 
● Context-Aware Recommendations — suggests bundles based on user purpose (e.g., 
“launch a small food business”)

Core Features:

● Real-time order tracking 
● Return and refund management

Advanced Features:

Differentiators:

● End-to-End Transparency Dashboard for buyers and sellers

 Trust, Security & Compliance

 Platform Architecture & UX 
Core Features: 
● Responsive web + mobile app (iOS/Android) 
● Modular architecture (supports multi-vertical expansion) 
● Consistent UI design system 
● Light/Dark mode and accessibility compliance 
Advanced Features: 
● Progressive Web App (PWA) 
● Voice commerce and conversational UX 
● AI assistant for search and support 
Differentiators: 
● “One Hub Experience” — identical UX whether you’re hiring, buying, or selling 
● Cross-Vertical Continuity — same cart, wallet, and identity across all experiences
